summary.statement: The container keeps every cell it is given, interior included, in all cases. A boundary mesh does not, and how much it loses is reported per case. Solidifying a boundary recovers a closed solid's interior exactly — but only when the boundary is closed; a punched shell is reported open instead of being filled.
